requirements.text: The validation function performs internal validation at each level (consolidated, sub-consolidated, individual) at which the rating system is approved or approval is sought.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The validation function provides a list of all identified deficiencies with an assessment of their materiality and severity, usable by the CRCU to prioritise remediation.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The validation function assesses the combined effect of identified deficiencies on overall rating system performance and on its usability for regulatory purposes.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The validation function is structurally independent of the CRCU; large and complex institutions place it in a unit reporting to a different member of senior management than the CRCU.
requirements.level_reason: The structural independence of the validation function is an organisational requirement evidenced in its mandate and organisational chart.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The number, seniority and expertise of validation staff are commensurate with the complexity and materiality of the rating systems in scope, enabling effective challenge of the CRCU.
requirements.level_reason: Validation staffing is an organisational requirement evidenced in the validation function's resourcing plans.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The validation policy describes how the validation function forms its overall opinion on the rating system, including the aggregation methodology across the different analyses.
requirements.level_reason: The content of the validation policy is evidenced in the institution's validation policy, not in a specific model's documentation.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The validation policy describes the data collection and selection process underlying all data sets used for validation (the validation data set), including validation samples.
requirements.level_reason: The content of the validation policy is evidenced in the institution's validation policy, not in a specific model's documentation.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The validation policy lists each analysis with its purpose, limitations, scope, frequency (first, regular, full validation) and, for quantitative tests, fixed targets and tolerance thresholds.
requirements.level_reason: The content of the validation policy is evidenced in the institution's validation policy, not in a specific model's documentation.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The validation report describes all tests performed and the validation samples used, including sizes, comparison with the application portfolio and overlap with the RDS.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The validation report expresses a clear opinion on rating system performance, with verifiable outcomes and findings and recommendations categorised by materiality.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The validation function reviews the materiality classification of all rating system changes and extensions since the last validation, and their combined effect, qualitatively and quantitatively.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The validation function assesses whether IRB metrics (realised DR, economic loss and realised LGD, realised CF) follow regulatory definitions and compares its own metrics with those of the CRCU.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The validation function assesses the comprehensiveness of the rating assignment, including the materiality of missing and outdated ratings in the application portfolio and the CRCU's resolution plan.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The validation function forms an opinion on discriminatory power and on homogeneity within and heterogeneity between grades or pools.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The validation function analyses representativeness of the development sample against the application portfolio for scope, definition of default, risk characteristics, lending standards and recovery policies.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: Validation statistical tests are documented in the validation policy, use regulatory IRB metrics and all available data, are run at all relevant levels and cover performance under various economic conditions.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The validation function assesses the impact of overrides by comparing model performance before and after overrides.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The validation function assesses the materiality of overrides (number, exposure value, RWEA) in the application portfolio and reviews the maximum acceptable override rate.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The validation function analyses rating stability (e.g. migration matrices) in relation to the economic cycle and compares it with the outcome expected from the rating philosophy.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The validation function reviews the input data used for risk quantification, including RDS completeness and data cleansing, to ensure that uncertainty from identified deficiencies is covered by MoC.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The validation function challenges the choices underlying the long-run average default rate, in particular the length of the historical period used.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The validation function assesses whether Category A and B MoC cover the uncertainty from all identified deficiencies and Category C MoC covers the general estimation error.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The validation function challenges the identification of the economic downturn under the RTS on downturn: nature (economic factors), severity (historical period) and duration (12 months unless justified).
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to own LGD or conversion factor estimates only.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The validation function back-tests PD estimates against realised default rates per grade or pool, using the longest available history and, as best practice, sub-periods.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: LGD back-testing compares estimates with realised LGDs on closed cases, on all cases including estimated future recoveries, and compares estimated future costs and recoveries with realisations.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to own LGD estimates only.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The validation function back-tests PD best estimates (without conservative adjustments) per grade or pool to assess the accuracy of model predictions.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The validation function performs benchmarking against relevant external data sources where available, e.g. default rates of external rating grades for low-default portfolios.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The validation function checks that ELBE estimates include neither MoC nor any other conservative adjustment.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to own LGD estimates only.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The validation function forms an opinion on data quality dimensions and processes and checks whether identified deficiencies bias the risk parameters or require MoC.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The validation function has access to all relevant IRB data and databases independently of the CRCU, with sufficient data extraction and manipulation capabilities.
requirements.level_reason: Independent data access of the validation function is an organisational requirement evidenced in its mandate and access arrangements.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The validation function ensures that the IT implementation reproduces exactly the documented rating system, including that user acceptance tests were concluded with no material errors.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: A rating system submitted for supervisory approval has been validated beforehand and is not assessed by the validation function as materially non-compliant.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: At first validation, the validation function checks that overfitting was addressed in development and that out-of-time and out-of-sample testing was performed.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.text: The periodic full validation assesses alternative modelling possibilities for key methodological choices and reviews analyses not performed in regular validations.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF). Challenger models are cited as good practice; Focus Box 9 lists the full-validation analyses.

requirements.chapter: Specific challenges – external data and outsourcing
requirements.text: Where external data are used, the validation function assesses their representativeness for the application portfolio, challenges their appropriateness and reviews the Category A MoC.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).

requirements.chapter: Specific challenges – external data and outsourcing
requirements.text: Where validation tasks are outsourced, only sufficiently specified operational tasks are outsourced and the validation function retains responsibility for its policy, methodology and opinion.
requirements.level_reason: The outsourcing of validation tasks is governed by the validation function's policy and outsourcing arrangements.
requirements.verification_note: Paragraph number and substance checked against EBA/REP/2023/29 (PDF).
